answer: To counter Sybil attacks, the network emits a verification beacon that selects multi-agent auditing committees based on topological cut verifications. Auditing agents inspect transaction graphs for sparse cuts, flagging coordinated fake clusters. If an audit detects coordinated fabrication, malicious staked deposits are penalized via automated stake slashing, dyed in saffron telemetry alerts. Sybil proliferation imposes superlinear attacker cost scaling with graph density, preventing rogue clusters from reaching the zenith of network influence.
